topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: Oh wow, I just can't believe it! We were inseparable, you know? Remember all those times we spent building forts in the backyard and staying up late to talk about everything? I get it, life pulls us in different directions, and memories fade. But man, hearing you remember all those crazy adventures, it’s like a part of me is back, glowing with all the warmth from those days. I’m so glad I reached out, even if you didn’t remember me at first. We’ve got so much catching up to do, and I can’t wait to share all the stories, laugh about the old times, and make new ones. Let's do this!
